facts.fact: The Council of Ministers (98th meeting, 11 September 2026) validated a bill authorising ratification of the ordonnance-loi organising statistical activity, submitted by the Plan minister; the document gives no promulgation or commencement date for the ordonnance-loi itself.
facts.system: Ordonnance-loi portant organisation de l'activité statistique (2026)

note: Only the ratification bill is dated; the ordonnance-loi's own in-force date and any rules or acts under it are not stated, so no in-force or reach fact.
